jobs.occupation: Orderpicker (Vast Night)-  Logistics Company in Evergem
jobs.description:
Job Description

As an order picker, you are an essential part of the logistics process. Your responsibilities include:

 
• 
 
Picking and preparing orders for shipment

 
 
• 
 
Performing quality checks on goods

 
 
• 
 
Keeping the warehouse clean and organized

 
 
• 
 
Collaborating with colleagues and other departments

 

You will work in a fixed night shift:

 
• 
 
Hours: 10:15 PM – 5:15 AM

 

Candidate Profile

We are looking for motivated order pickers with:

 
• 
 
Experience in a logistics or warehouse environment

 
 
• 
 
Willingness to work in a fixed night shift

 
 
• 
 
An accurate and structured work approach

 
 
• 
 
Strong communication skills and a team?oriented mindset

 
 
• 
 
Fluency in English

 
 
• 
 
Experience with an electric pallet truck (BT) or a valid BT certificate

Job Description – Your Responsibilities

As a waste handler & industrial cleaner, you are responsible for maintaining a clean and safe warehouse. Your tasks include:

 
• 
 
Carrying cardboard and waste from picking areas to the correct containers

 
 
• 
 
Cleaning the warehouse and work zones

 
 
• 
 
Cleaning equipment and installations

 
 
• 
 
Contributing to a tidy, safe, and organized work environment

 

Working Hours

You can work in:

 
• 
 
Two?shift system

 
 
• 
 
Early shift: 05:15 – 13:45 (Friday until 12:45)

 
 
• 
 
Late shift: 13:45 – 22:15 (Friday until 20:15)

 
 
 
 
• 
 
Fixed night shift

 
 
• 
 
22:15 – 05:15 (Friday until 02:45)

 
 
 

Candidate Profile – Your Skills

We are looking for candidates who:

 
• 
 
Are physically fit and not afraid to roll up their sleeves

 
 
• 
 
Speak and understand Dutch or English well

 
 
• 
 
Are reliable, accurate, and true team players

 
 
• 
 
Have experience in industrial cleaning (a plus, but not required)

Job Description

What will your day look like?

As a loader/unloader, you play an essential role in the warehouse operations. Your main responsibilities include:

 
• 
 
Loading and unloading trucks

 
 
• 
 
Handling and lifting heavy packages (physical fitness required)

 
 
• 
 
Working in a fast?paced and dynamic environment

 
 
• 
 
Supporting warehouse activities during day shifts and rotating shifts

 

In the long term, you will have the opportunity to learn how to operate a forklift and/or reach truck, offering great potential for growth.

Candidate Profile

Our ideal loader/unloader has:

 
• 
 
Good physical condition

 
 
• 
 
Experience with BT equipment (certificate is a strong plus)

 
 
• 
 
Willingness to work in shifts and occasional night shifts

 
 
• 
 
A hands?on mentality and proactive attitude

 
 
• 
 
Enjoyment in working in a dynamic logistics environment

 
 
• 
 
Fluency in Dutch or English

As a Team Leader, you are the right-hand person of the Supervisor and lead a team of approximately 12 warehouse operators. You ensure that all rules and procedures related to cleanliness, safety, and quality are followed, and that the warehouse is always maintained to the highest standards.

You work closely alongside your team on the warehouse equipment and are primarily responsible for operational leadership and guidance. You collaborate closely with the Supervisor, who is your direct manager.

What does our ideal Team Leader look like?

As a Team Leader, you are fluent in Dutch and have strong communication skills in English. Knowledge of French is considered an asset. Ideally, you have experience working in a logistics warehouse environment and have already held a supervisory or leadership role.

You are a team player who is accurate, independent, positive-minded, and driven to achieve results. You possess the necessary leadership skills to motivate and guide your team effectively, and you hold a valid forklift or reach truck certificate.

jobs.occupation: Oliver James Associates - Senior Azure / .NET Architect
jobs.description:
We're reimagining a mission-critical communication platform that powers how systems exchange data, files, and events with the outside world. This is not a greenfield toy project-it's a high-impact transformation at scale.

As a Senior Azure .NET Architect, you'll help design and shape a next-generation, cloud-native integration platform. You'll take an existing, complex ecosystem and turn it into a resilient, high-performance, event-driven architecture running on Azure.

If you enjoy solving hard distributed systems problems and building platforms that truly matter-this role is for you.
💡 What you'll be doing

You won't just "contribute"-you'll shape the future architecture:

• Design and build a modern communication layer handling message and file ingestion, transformation, routing, and delivery (sync + async)

• Create resilient, fault-tolerant systems using proven patterns like retries, circuit breakers, idempotency, and event-driven workflows

• Architect scalable event-driven solutions using Azure messaging services and/or Kafka-style pub/sub systems

• Build high-quality .NET services (.NET 7/8, C#, ASP.NET Core, gRPC/REST) with a strong engineering culture (TDD, clean code, performance-first)

• Deploy and operate workloads on Kubernetes (AKS/OpenShift) using Helm and modern CI/CD pipelines

• Define observability from day one: logging, tracing, metrics, SLOs, and actionable runbooks

• Collaborate in a truly agile setup, working closely with engineers, product owners, and other teams

• Mentor and elevate others-your experience will help raise the bar across the team

🎯 Why this role stands out

• High impact: You're building a core platform that everything depends on

• Real engineering challenges: Distributed systems, scalability, resilience-no trivial work here

• Modern tech stack: Cloud-native, Kubernetes, event-driven, .NET latest

• Ownership & influence: Your architectural decisions will shape the platform long-term

• Collaborative culture: Work with experienced engineers who care about doing things right

• Extensive experience in software engineering (15+ years), including building distributed, high-throughput, or mission-critical systems

• Strong hands-on Azure expertise (AKS, Functions, messaging services, Storage, monitoring, CI/CD)

• Deep knowledge of .NET (C#, modern .NET, async programming, testing practices)

• Solid understanding of event-driven architecture and distributed system trade-offs

• Experience with Docker and Kubernetes in production environments

• A mindset focused on quality, automation, and continuous improvement

• Confidence to make architectural decisions and guide others

• Strong communication skills in English

 

🌟 bonus points:

• Experience with observability stacks (Opentelemetry, tracing, logging platforms)

• Exposure to large-scale messaging or file transfer systems

• Knowledge of secure integration protocols (e.g., sFTP, AS2/AS4, messaging queues)

• Experience working in regulated or high-reliability environments
